title: CoGameReg: Cooperative-Game-Based Collaborative Semi-Supervised Regression for Seismic Reservoir Property Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.12884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate estimation of reservoir properties from seismic data remains challenging when well-log labels are sparse but three-dimensional seismic observations are abundant. We present CoGameReg, a cooperative-game-based semi-supervised regression framework that uses contribution-weighted predictions of heterogeneous regressors to construct shared pseudo-labels. This design makes each regressor's influence explicit in the learning targets generated for unlabeled seismic samples under sparse well control. The Tri-Game Shapley mechanism combines a rank-MSE performance game with a pairwise consistency game to estimate nonnegative regressor weights from labeled training data. These weights remain fixed during collaborative training and are reused for final prediction fusion. Candidate pseudo-labels are screened using a common local k-nearest-neighbor error-reduction criterion before retraining. We evaluate CoGameReg on 10 public regression data

translated_title: CoGameReg：基于合作博弈的协同半监督回归用于地震储层物性预测
translated_abstract: 当测井标签稀疏而三维地震观测数据丰富时，从地震数据中准确估计储层物性仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了CoGameReg，这是一个基于合作博弈的半监督回归框架，利用异构回归器的贡献加权预测来构建共享伪标签。这种设计使每个回归器的影响在稀疏井控条件下为无标签地震样本生成的学习目标中得以显式体现。三重博弈Shapley机制将秩-MSE性能博弈与成对一致性博弈相结合，从有标签训练数据中估计非负的回归器权重。这些权重在协同训练期间保持固定，并被重复用于最终的预测融合。在重新训练之前，采用共同的局部k近邻误差减少准则对候选伪标签进行筛选。我们在10个公共回归数据集上对CoGameReg进行了评估（摘要此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了基于合作博弈的半监督回归框架CoGameReg，通过三重博弈Shapley机制为异构回归器分配非负贡献权重，利用贡献加权伪标签在井标签稀疏条件下实现更准确的地震储层物性预测。
en_tdlr: CoGameReg is a cooperative-game-based semi-supervised regression framework that employs a Tri-Game Shapley mechanism to assign contribution weights to heterogeneous regressors, enabling accurate seismic reservoir property prediction from sparse well-log labels via contribution-weighted pseudo-labels.
